name: Delete an Individual Team
description: Delete an Individual Team Delete a team with a SCIM Group DELETE Request. DELETE /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/scim/v2/Groups/{team_id_or_slug}

name: Delete an Organization Member via SCIM
description: Delete an Organization Member via SCIM Delete an organization member with a SCIM User DELETE Request. DELETE /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/scim/v2/Users/{member_id}

name: Query an Individual Team
description: Query an Individual Team Query an individual team with a SCIM Group GET Request. GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/scim/v2/Groups/{team_id_or_slug}

name: Query an Individual Organization Member
description: Query an Individual Organization Member Query an individual organization member with a SCIM User GET Request. GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/scim/v2/Users/{member_id}

name: List an Organization's Paginated Teams
description: List an Organization's Paginated Teams Returns a paginated list of teams bound to a organization with a SCIM Groups GET Request. GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/scim/v2/Groups
context:
GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/scim/v2/Groups
Returns a paginated list of teams bound to a organization with a SCIM Groups GET Request. Note that the members field will only contain up to 10,000 members.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
Optional: startIndex (query) — SCIM 1-offset based index for pagination.; count (query) — The maximum number of results the query should return, maximum of 100.; filter (query) — A SCIM filter expression. The only operator currently supported is `eq`.; excludedAttributes (query) — Fields that should be left off of return values. Right now the only supported field for this query is members.

name: List an Organization's SCIM Members
description: List an Organization's SCIM Members Returns a paginated list of members bound to a organization with a SCIM Users GET Request. GET /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/scim/v2/Users
context:

The only operator currently supported is `eq`.; excludedAttributes (query) — Fields that should be left off of return values. Right now the only supported field for this query is members.

name: Provision a New Team
description: Provision a New Team Create a new team bound to an organization via a SCIM Groups POST Request. POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/scim/v2/Groups
context:
POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/scim/v2/Groups
Create a new team bound to an organization via a SCIM Groups POST Request. The slug will have a normalization of uppercases/spaces to lowercases and dashes. Note that teams are always created with an empty member set.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; body (body)

name: Provision a New Organization Member
description: Provision a New Organization Member Create a new Organization Member via a SCIM Users POST Request. POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/scim/v2/Users
context:
POST /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/scim/v2/Users
Create a new Organization Member via a SCIM Users POST Request. Note that this API does not support setting secondary emails.
Required: organization_id_or_slug (path) — The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.; body (body)

name: Update a Team's Attributes
description: Update a Team's Attributes Update a team's attributes with a SCIM Group PATCH Request. PATCH /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/scim/v2/Groups/{team_id_or_slug}

name: Update an Organization Member's Attributes
description: Update an Organization Member's Attributes Update an organization member's attributes with a SCIM PATCH Request. PATCH /api/0/organizations/{organization_id_or_slug}/scim/v2/Users/{member_id}
